name: Cryonic-Cwm
description: Cold has crystallized everything here into geometry: dune-fields of frost, canyons of clear blue ice, and far off, past towering mountain ranges, a light that lingers blue long after sunset.

The air carries wet iron and lichen, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Leviathan fauna breach the sea-mist at dusk, singing on frequencies felt in the teeth.
Approach protocols for the quarantine zone are simple: announce once, dock slowly, compliment the cooking.
The quarantine perimeter has held for years, mostly out of mutual disinterest. Everyone checks the fence anyway.
